issues.description: Functional requirement 'The system shall lock a user account after a specified number of failed login attempts' is missing measurable acceptance criteria for the number of failed attempts.
issues.suggested_fix: Add specific number of failed attempts to the requirement.

issues.description: Use case goal 'Logout from the system' has no matching functional requirement.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a functional requirement to handle logout functionality.

issues.description: Functional requirement 'The system shall validate user credentials' is ambiguous and does not specify what constitutes valid credentials.
issues.suggested_fix: Clarify the validation criteria for user credentials.

issues.description: Functional requirement 'The system shall return a LOGIN_SUCCESS event upon successful authentication' is missing measurable acceptance criteria for what constitutes a successful authentication.
issues.suggested_fix: Add specific criteria for successful authentication to the requirement.

issues.description: The system shall lock a user account after a specified number of failed login attempts. (missing measurable acceptance criteria)
issues.suggested_fix: Add specific threshold for failed login attempts

issues.description: The system shall automatically unlock a locked user account after a specified time period. (missing measurable acceptance criteria)
issues.suggested_fix: Add specific time period for automatic unlocking

issues.description: The system shall rate-limit login attempts to prevent brute-force attacks. (ambiguous definition of rate limiting)
issues.suggested_fix: Define specific rate limiting rules and thresholds

issues.description: No functional requirement for handling expired access tokens
issues.suggested_fix: Add functional requirement for handling expired access tokens

issues.description: Functional requirement 'The system shall provide a multi-factor authentication mechanism to verify user identities' lacks measurable acceptance criteria.
issues.suggested_fix: Add specific details on the types of factors and verification methods.

issues.description: Functional requirement 'The system shall allow users to recover their passwords via email notification' is ambiguous about the recovery process.
issues.suggested_fix: Clarify the steps involved in password recovery.

issues.description: Use case goal 'Change password from Account Settings' has no matching functional requirement.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a functional requirement to support this use case.

issues.description: Exception condition 'account lock due to failed sign-in attempts' is not fully covered by any requirement.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a functional requirement or clarify existing ones to address this scenario.

issues.description: The system shall authenticate a user using their credentials. Missing measurable acceptance criteria for successful authentication.
issues.suggested_fix: Add specific criteria, e.g., 'within 2 seconds' or 'with a success rate of 99.9%'.

issues.description: The system shall refresh an access token when the existing one is near expiration or has expired. Missing measurable acceptance criteria for 'near expiration'.
issues.suggested_fix: Define a specific time threshold, e.g., 'within 5 minutes of expiration'.

issues.description: Terminate session use case goal has no matching functional requirement for session termination due to security policy violation.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a functional requirement, e.g., 'The system shall terminate the current session when a security policy is violated'.

issues.description: The system shall terminate the current session when requested by the user or when a security policy is violated. Ambiguous definition of 'security policy violation'.
issues.suggested_fix: Provide specific examples or criteria for what constitutes a security policy violation.
